items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Frank Wess was directing the band. We had Julius Pogue, Pete Pogue, Fathead Pogue... And they had Wallace Cryer playing baritone. Buck Hill...

ctx.x: Yeah, something like that. '27... Frank and them..> That's when Bix came up with him, in '27.
